retweet.text:
When Elon Musk talks about abundance, I think about people having more room to breathe because the things they need become less expensive to provide.

That is the possibility I find compelling in Terafab. Its planned chips are meant to support AI and robots, and if those systems help us produce goods and deliver services more efficiently, the benefits could reach far beyond the technology industry, into the cost of everyday life.

For me, that is what makes a chip factory worth caring about. The meaningful version of abundance is not simply having more impressive machines, but building a future in which meeting ordinary needs puts less pressure on ordinary people.

quoted.text:
Starlink helped save five people stranded in Kazakhstan’s snowy mountains. ♥️

Their SUV broke down about 15 km from the village of Kystau Kurchum. There was no mobile network they could use. Starlink got their call for help through and kept them in touch with rescuers, who used the connection to find them.

Crews drove about 100 km in an all-terrain vehicle and brought all five safely back to the village.

For people stranded far from help, Starlink can be lifesaving technology.
